ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Freezes on Minnesota's Medicaid Program
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's freeze on $2 billion in Medicaid funds to Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The human impact of federal funding disputes
questions: How will the funding freeze affect Minnesota's Medicaid program?
What are the implications for vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the consequences of federal funding disputes on state Medicaid programs and the populations they serve.

ideas.title: The Renee Good Shooting Investigation: A Review of the Facts

ideas.angle: A fact-based analysis of the investigation
questions: What are the key facts surrounding the Renee Good shooting?
How has the investigation been handled?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a comprehensive understanding of the investigation and its implications.
